not_used.reason: the Brazilian CPI is already in this set as FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG, from the same source and the same vintage as the GDP deflator it is compared against. Mixing a BCB series with a WDI series would put a source difference inside a wedge the video attributes to basket composition.

derived.lambda: data/check_lambda.py -- Jones-Klenow four-term decomposition for BRA vs USA, sigma=1, leisure term omitted (no verified hours series), ubar reported at 0/5/10 because it has no market price. Closed form checked against a 400k-draw Monte Carlo of E[ln c]-ln E[c] against -s^2/2.
